pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, multi-sided polygonal patches with soft-to-moderately-sharp pixel gradients. Patches on the central flank exhibit greater spatial area and elongation compared to the smaller, more compact patches on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored negative-space pathways. Topology is characterized by frequent three-way and four-way junction nodes. Pathway thickness is variable, narrowing between larger flank patches and widening towards the ventral region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the dorsal neck line with a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The contour is dark brown and contrasts against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: An abrupt discontinuity in the mane's linear profile is present at the junction of the neck and shoulder, partially due to the occlusion and physical presence of an avian hitchhiker.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an oxpecker bird perched on the dorsal ridge near the shoulder-neck junction.
